finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.assumptions: The code does not involve any user input or external data that could be manipulated to inject commands. The signal handling is controlled and does not involve any command execution.

finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: Reading and writing to the pipe with a single byte buffer
finding.assumptions: The pipe communication is used for synchronization and does not involve any user input or external data that could be manipulated to inject commands.

finding.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
finding.trigger: Reading and writing to the pipe with a single byte buffer
finding.assumptions: The pipe communication is used for synchronization and does not involve any user input or external data that could cause integer overflow.

finding.title: Improper Release of a Resource ('Resource Leak')
finding.trigger: Setting the signal handler with SA_RESETHAND flag
finding.assumptions: The signal handler is reset to default after the first delivery, but there is no explicit check or cleanup for the pipe resources.
